content: According to research, tropical rainforests and coniferous forests are two of the types of trees that produce the highest amount of oxygen relative to other tree species. Tropical rainforests, in particular, are known for their high levels of productivity and biodiversity, which enable them to generate significant amounts of oxygen through photosynthesis. Additionally, certain species of algae and cyanobacteria also play a crucial role in oxygen production in aquatic environments.
